requirements.statement: Guests sign in through the shared identity provider to access the blog

criteria.must: An unauthenticated guest is prompted to sign in through the shared identity provider before accessing the blog
After signing in, the guest reaches the blog's content

requirements.statement: Guests can see a list of published posts

criteria.must: A signed-in guest sees a list of the blog's published posts

requirements.statement: Guests can open a post and read its full content

criteria.must: Selecting a post from the list opens its full content

requirements.statement: Guests can see the comments on a post

criteria.must: A post's page shows the comments left on it

requirements.statement: Guests can add a comment to a post

criteria.must: A signed-in guest can submit a comment on a post
A submitted comment appears among the post's comments
A guest cannot edit or delete a comment once it is posted

requirements.statement: The admin signs in through the shared identity provider to manage the blog

criteria.must: An unauthenticated admin is prompted to sign in through the shared identity provider before accessing the admin app

requirements.statement: The admin can create a new post

criteria.must: The admin can submit a new post with a title and body
A created post becomes visible to guests immediately, with no draft state

requirements.statement: The admin can edit an existing post

criteria.must: The admin can change an existing post's title or body
The edited content is reflected when the post is viewed again

requirements.statement: The admin can delete a post

criteria.must: The admin can delete an existing post
A deleted post no longer appears to guests

requirements.statement: The admin can see all posts in one place to manage the blog's content

criteria.must: The admin app shows a single view listing every post

requirements.statement: The admin can remove a comment guests have left

criteria.must: The admin can delete an existing comment on a post
A deleted comment no longer appears to guests

requirements.statement: Both the guest and admin apps authenticate through the same shared identity provider, and the system makes no calls to any outside service

criteria.must: The guest app and the admin app use the same sign-in provider
No feature in either app depends on a third-party or outside API
